name: Odyssee Technologies
summary: Odyssee Technologies is an engineering firm focused on precision mechanics, supplying critical components across a broad spectrum of industries, including aeronautics, defense, space, and energy. Their extensive product range includes parts for hydraulic and braking systems in aircraft, as well as general spare parts and custom prototypes. For the defense sector, they manufacture components and subassemblies for artillery and military vehicles. Within the energy industry, Odyssee provides items like gas turbine blades and specialized industrial pump components, such as those for cryogenic applications. Their contributions to space exploration feature flight-ready parts, including waveguides, various satellite structural elements, and rocket engine components. Beyond these, the company also produces machinery tailored for diverse industrial sectors like pharmaceuticals, packaging, and optics. Incorporated in 2011 and headquartered in Les Premiers-Sapins, France, Odyssee Technologies also actively exports its sophisticated products worldwide.
